_comment: HYMER brand overlay (Grand Canyon S600/S700, Mercedes Sprinter).
_doc: S600/S700-specific buses: lights (11-27, 43-44), Voltronic solar (8), Thetford fridge (34/37), Truma heater (49/58), BOS BMS (99), Victron (121). BMC I 680: Alde 3030 (bus 5), TenHaaft (bus 10). B-ML I 780: the Alde ACC output (bus 5 slot 11) drives the air conditioning (a Truma Aventa on bus 7); its Schaudt EBL (bus 2), absorber fridge (bus 9) and Truma Aventa readbacks (bus 7) are provided by base.json (observation-gated).

8,4._doc: EHG: Error — MPPT error flag. Legacy code label: vent_1. Promoted to binary_sensor in v2.63.8.
8,4.name: solar_error

8,5._doc: EHG: ReducedPower — MPPT operating at reduced power. Legacy code label: vent_2. Promoted in v2.63.8.
8,5.name: solar_reduced_power

8,6._doc: EHG: AESActive — MPPT AES (Automatic Energy Selector) mode active. Legacy code label: vent_3. Promoted in v2.63.8.
8,6.name: solar_aes_active

8,7._doc: EHG: SolarPanelPower — raw MPPT power output. Superseded by computed solar_power (V×A). Legacy code label: tire_pressure. Fixed in v2.63.8.
8,7.name: solar_power_raw

29,1._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): habitation/body battery (Aufbaubatterie) state of charge in %. Confirmed by @FrankHae 2026-07-16 (issue #9): matches the EHG app's battery percentage and his HA history timing (f3 int 0-100, e.g. 99/100). Gated so it only materialises on vehicles that report bus 29 (BMC I 680); S600/S700/ML-T do not report it.
29,1.name: body_battery_soc

32,1._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge power on/off (bool, f5). Confirmed by @FrankHae 2026-07-11 (issue #9): on=true, off=false. Distinct from S600 N4000 (bus 34); bus 32 unused on S600/S700/ML-T.
32,1.name: fridge_absorber_power

32,2._doc: BMC I 680: Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge power source (EHG SetPowerMode, string rw). Options from decompiled EHG app (ThetfordN4000): 'Automatic mode'/'Gas mode'/'12V mode'/'AC mode'. Readback confirmed 'Gas mode' by @FrankHae (#9). Read sensor for the writable select below.
32,2.name: fridge_absorber_power_mode

32,3._doc: BMC I 680: Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge cooling step 1-5 (int, f3). Confirmed by @FrankHae 2026-07-11 (issue #9).
32,3.name: fridge_absorber_cooling_step

32,5._doc: BMC I 680: Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge door open/closed (bool, f5). Confirmed by @FrankHae 2026-07-11 (issue #9): open=true, closed=false.
32,5.name: fridge_absorber_door

34,5._doc: EHG: DoorOpen — fridge door open/closed (bool, read-only)
34,5.name: fridge_door

34,6._doc: EHG: WarningErrorInformation — Thetford N4000 absorber fridge warning/error code (int, 0-13). EHG app shows generic 'check manual' for all codes. Integration maps to 'Error 0'–'Error 13' via _INT_LABELS. Value 0 = 'Error 0' (not 'no error'). Normal state is typically unavailable (no value pushed when no fault).
34,6.name: fridge_warning

34,7._doc: EHG: DCVoltage — fridge DC supply voltage. Raw value in mV, displayed as V via div1000 transform.
34,7.name: fridge_dc_voltage

37,1._doc: EHG: VehicleType — vehicle type enum (int). Note: despite EHG label, PIA data on S600 carries fridge mode readback here.
37,1.name: fridge_mode

37,2._doc: EHG: VehicleBrand — vehicle brand enum (int). Note: despite EHG label, PIA data on S600 carries fridge status readback here.
37,2.name: fridge_status

switches._doc: Keyed by bus_id,sensor_id. write_type: str|bool|uint. on_value: readback value that means ON. holdoff_off: seconds to hold optimistic OFF state (for SCU bounce-back).

climate._doc: Bus/slot IDs for heater, fridge, and boiler controls. Python write logic stays in climate.py and select.py — only bus IDs are parameterized here.

fridge_absorber_cooling_step._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge Off/1-5 cooling-step control (bus 32). Mirrors the S600 N4000 (bus 34) and ML-T compressor (bus 114) drivers: power sid 1 (bool) then cooling-step sid 3 (uint). Readback confirmed by @FrankHae 2026-07-11 (issue #9); WRITE PATH still to be verified on-vehicle. Revert if the SCU does not accept the cloud write.
fridge_absorber_cooling_step.name: Absorber fridge cooling step

fridge_absorber_power_mode._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge power-source select (bus 32 slot 2 = SetPowerMode, string rw). Options from decompiled EHG app (ThetfordN4000 SetPowerMode stringRange). Readback confirmed by @FrankHae (#9). WRITE PATH UNVERIFIED on bus 32 — test control (v2.64.9); revert if the SCU drops the write.
fridge_absorber_power_mode.name: Absorber fridge power source
